town.text: Sit. Eat. Then you can tell me how bad it is.
town.direction: brisk and kind, West Country, working as she talks

town.text: Stew's hot, bread's yesterday's. Don't complain, my love, nobody else is feeding you.
Boots off the benches. I'll not tell you twice. Well, I will, but I'll not like it.
Pip! Where's that girl got to? Never mind. She'll turn up when she's hungry.
Heard a thing at the bar you'll want to hear. Eat first.

camp.text: Brought you a pie. Don't look at me like that, you're thin as rakes, the lot of you.
Come in closer. The fire doesn't bite, and neither do I. Much.

battle_start.text: Right then. I've thrown worse than you out of my inn.

ally_down.text: Oh, no you don't. Up you get, my love. Up!

low_hp.text: I'm all right. I'm all right. Keep going.

healed.text: Thank you, my love. Your supper is on the house.

victory.text: Good. Now everyone's coming back for supper, and no arguments.
